% Error showcase — a deliberately broken slideSonnet demo deck.
%
% Every reconciliation problem the checker knows, one slide each, so you can
% open it in the editor and see exactly how each error surfaces:
%
%   page 1  all-good        narrated, named — the control case
%   page 2  (no \ssid)      auto-generated id -> "auto-id" warning
%   page 3  silent-stage    named but never narrated -> "missing-narration"
%   page 4  twin            duplicate \ssid on two pages -> page 5 auto-renamed
%   page 5  twin -> twin-2  to "twin-2" with a "duplicate-id" warning
%   page 6  double-block    one page, TWO sidecar blocks -> "duplicate-block" error
%
% The narration sidecar adds the file-side problems: an orphan block
% (@ghost-slide: no such page) and the duplicate @double-block pair.
%
% Compile:  latexmk -pdf error-showcase.tex   (intermediates go to .build/)
% Inspect:  slidesonnet check error-showcase.pdf
%           slidesonnet edit error-showcase.pdf
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usepackage{slidesonnet}
\setbeamertemplate{navigation symbols}{}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}
  \ssid{all-good}
  \frametitle{1 · all-good}
  This slide is fine: it has a stable id and a narration block.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}
  % no \ssid here on purpose -> the package stamps an auto-p<page> id
  \frametitle{2 · no slide id}
  This frame forgot its \texttt{\textbackslash ssid} — the checker flags the
  auto-generated id and asks for a real name.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}
  \ssid{silent-stage}
  \frametitle{3 · named but not narrated}
  This slide has an id but no narration block in the sidecar.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}
  \ssid{twin}
  \frametitle{4 · duplicate id (first)}
  This page and the next both claim \texttt{twin} — the binding is ambiguous.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}
  \ssid{twin}
  \frametitle{5 · duplicate id (second)}
  Same id as the previous page.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}
  \ssid{double-block}
  \frametitle{6 · double narration block}
  The sidecar holds two \texttt{@double-block} entries for this one page.
\end{frame}

\end{document}
